title: AAE's LeGrand develops smarter ways to track satellites beyond Earth's orbit
summary_en: Purdue University engineer Keith LeGrand is developing methods to track the location and movement of objects in cislunar space — the area around Earth extending to just beyond the moon's orbit, which encompasses upwards of 300,000 miles, or roughly 12 times around the Earth's equator.
title_cn: AAE's LeGrand develops smarter ways to track satellites beyond Earth's orbit

title: Purdue MEM Students work with Egyptian diagnostics startup Reme-D to build scalable customer support system
summary_en: A team of students in Purdue University’s Master of Engineering Management (MEM) program partnered with Egyptian diagnostics startup Reme-D to develop a customer feedback and support system designed to improve communication, streamline issue resolution and support the company's continued growth across the Middle East and Africa.
title_cn: Purdue MEM Students work with Egyptian diagnostics startup Reme-D to build scalable customer support system

title: Innovation, collaboration help engineering student build confidence in the classroom and on the track
summary_en: Sometimes a child’s toy can lead to inspiration for where to go to college. That’s what happened to Youssuf Elhawary, who’s originally from Cairo, Egypt.
title_cn: Innovation, collaboration help engineering student build confidence in the classroom and on the track

title: Purdue MEM students partner with EatCloud to expand food rescue through AI-powered WhatsApp solution
summary_en: A team of students in Purdue University’s Master of Engineering Management (MEM) program partnered with Colombia-based social enterprise EatCloud to develop technology solutions aimed at reducing food waste while expanding access to food for communities in need.
title_cn: Purdue MEM students partner with EatCloud to expand food rescue through AI-powered WhatsApp solution
